issues.detail: The Greek 'ινα μη το χωλον εκτραπη ιαθη δε μαλλον' means 'so that the lame person might not be twisted/stumbled, but rather healed.' The Vietnamese translation 'để kẻ què khỏi bị trẹo, nhưng thà được chữa lành' uses 'thà' (rather/preferably), which implies a choice or preference. The Greek 'δε μαλλον' functions as a contrastive 'but rather,' indicating the intended outcome of the action (healing) rather than a subjective preference.
